title: A Merry Little Turn Up Girls Day!
seo_title: A Merry Little Turn Up Girls Day! in Joplin, MO
description: This annual Christmas party includes a paint-by-numbers snowman craft and a small gift exchange. The $15 kit comes with a frame, numbered canvas, brushes, and numbered paints, so no freehand drawing is needed; reserve a spot ahead of time, bring a wrapped gift under $25 if you join the exchange, and enjoy the treats the host provides. It is for girls and women, with no painting experience needed, and takes place December 5, 2026 (Time TBD) at Every BODY Fitness, 2639 E 32nd St, Suite T, in Joplin, MO.
